text:
maria: heads-up — gpu CI (gpu-smoke / ubuntu-22 / A100) started failing on commit 7c9d2e2 in runtime. error in test harness: `CUDA driver version is insufficient for CUDA runtime` and we see NVML Xid=31 in the logs. dropping logs below. anyone seen this today?

chris: can you paste the runner + image? that message usually means driver < cuda runtime or container built for newer CUDA.

maria: runner: dgx-2-a100 (nodepool: gpu-a100-us-west), image: `redwood/ci-gpu:cuda12.1-cudnn8-202601`. nvidia-smi shows Driver Version: 510.47.03 on the host. full failed snippet:

```
[  120.345678] nvidia: loading out-of-tree module taints kernel.
[  120.346001] nvidia: probe of 0000:3d:00.0 failed with error -22
E CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&nGPU)) failed: CUDA driver version is insufficient for CUDA runtime (35)
E NVML: Xid (31): GPU page fault, engine 2
```

jess: 510 is definitely too old for CUDA 12.1 — I think we need >=525.x. infra pushed some older images to that pool yesterday.

infra-bot: @eng-ml noticed CI failure on gpu-smoke. A rerun can be triggered with `/retest ci gpu-smoke`.

maria: i kicked a rerun on a different pool (gpu-a100-upgrade) but it failed with same error. suspect container compiled against 12.1 won't work unless host drivers are bumped.

tom: i can try a quick local repro in a docker host with driver 510. reproduced the exact `insufficient for runtime` message. minimal repro: `docker run --gpus all --rm redwood/ci-gpu:cuda12.1-cudnn8-202601 nvidia-smi` -> error.

chris: short-term: can we pin CI to `redwood/ci-gpu:cuda11.8-cudnn8` for smoke job until infra upgrades drivers? longer-term infra needs to roll driver to 525+.

maria: opened PR to pin smoke job image -> https://git.redwood/infra/ci-config/pulls/2345 (pin to cuda11.8). added note to PR to revert after driver roll.

jess: filed infra ticket: INFRA-4821 requesting driver update to 525.60 on gpu-a100-us-west pool and included kernel/dkms reconciliation steps. cc @infra.

deploy-bot: Re-run requested by maria: job gpu-smoke #4523 started on pool gpu-a100-us-west-upgrade (ts=1860001175).

maria: quick update — infra rolled driver to 525.60 on a subset of nodes and reran the job. smoke passed on upgraded nodes. leaving pinned image until rollout is complete.

chris: nice. once rollout finishes, revert PR 2345 and we'll re-run full matrix.

maria: closing this thread once revert done. thanks all :thumbsup:
